$comment: THE ONE REGISTRY for the lattice's knobs (ADR-149). Read by /test/lattice (TS import through lib/lattice/variants.ts) and by scripts/capture-lattice.mjs (readFileSync); mirrored into the turnstone ship's armada.toml as [types.LT]. TYPE IDS ARE LETTERS ONLY. THE FIRST VALUE OF EVERY KNOB IS THE HOUSE: LA is every knob at its first value and the control; every other direction is one argument against it.

cut.label: Cut
cut.note: tr-bl = ADR-065's housing diagonal, the owner's ruling of 2026-10-06. tr = ADR-148's single top-right notch, house-wide.

line.label: Line
line.note: lip = a housing's one sanctioned gold line (ADR-089). seam = every frame in dawn, gold spent on marks alone.

head.label: Head
head.note: strip = the numbered head strip (an ordinal tab, a kicker, the title, the sub, one rule under — Evangelion's module head). bare = kicker and title alone, the sheet's own head today.

directions.name: House
directions.question: does one grid, one frame and one head strip read as one instrument across five boards at the house values?
directions.shape: the TR+BL pair on a gold lip, every section headed by its ordinal tab

directions.name: Notch
directions.question: does a single top-right notch on every frame read more minimal, or does a page of one-corner boxes lose its machined read?
directions.shape: the same page cut once per frame

directions.name: Dawn
directions.question: with every frame line in dawn, is gold left for the marks alone, and does the page still read as a device?
directions.shape: the same page with no gold on any edge

directions.name: Bare
directions.question: without the ordinal tab, does a section still know where it is on the page?
directions.shape: the same page headed by kicker and title alone

wave.note: 1280x720 is the binding cell; 1920x1247 is the owner's window. The jury scores the page board per cell.
